The structure of Li6Hf2Sn2 (reduced formula Li3HfSn) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom: Hf and Sn are each coordinated by 8 Li and 4 of the other element, while Li is surrounded by 4 Hf and 8 Sn. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Li-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Hf- and Sn-centered polyhedra.
